svg.title: Direct Sampling (DS) (Stone)
svg.text: Training image: Stone · n = 40 · th = 0.08 · f = 0.35 · simulated with G2S pyDev
Visit the next node of the random path
Take its data event: the n = 40 closest simulated nodes
Scan the training image at random positions, compute the distance
Stop at the first distance ≤ th = 0.08 (scan at most f = 35%)
Paste the value of that position into the simulation
